title: Odyssey Cultural Fest 2027
resources: Venue booking, sound system and a volunteer team of 20 students
risks: Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 330 attendees for this Cultural Fest, in line with turnout at our previous Cultural Fest events.
The requested budget of INR 72,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Cultural Fest.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will significantly increase student engagement and the visibility of our club.
